Bundled third-party scripts, served at `/vendor/<file>` so the pages work offline.
- `echarts.min.js`: Apache ECharts 5.5.1 (Apache-2.0), from cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/echarts@5.5.1/dist/
- `vis-network.min.js`: vis-network 9.1.9 standalone UMD (Apache-2.0 OR MIT), from unpkg.com/vis-network@9.1.9/standalone/umd/
